item.title: Daily Court Digest: Major environment orders (February 24, 2026)
item.description: Supreme Court mandates strict enforcement of Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, with local authorities accountable for compliance. Kerala High Court halts construction in Kottooli wetlands pending Ramsar status. NGT stops health centre construction in Odisha without pollution board consent.
